author: xbckz
description: Bounded, citation-ready evidence for AI agents: index native-text PDFs once, then search, cite, compare, and prepare context; fetch public web evidence; inspect OpenAPI contracts; and read Base chain data with x402 USDC payments.
name: Task402 Agent Evidence Tools

tools.name: generate_pdf
tools.title: Generate PDF
tools.description: Create a professionally formatted, paginated PDF from Markdown. Returns a short-lived download capability.

title.description: Human-readable title for the generated PDF.

markdown.description: Markdown content to paginate into the PDF.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: PDF job status, download capability, and settlement details.

tools.name: get_pdf_job
tools.title: Get PDF job status
tools.description: Read the status for a PDF job using its unguessable capability.

outputSchema.description: PDF job status, download capability, and settlement details.

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.title: Inspect PDF
tools.description: Inspect a previously uploaded PDF using its document capability. Upload binary PDFs through POST /v1/documents; persist both the returned capability and recovery key securely.

outputSchema.description: PDF metadata, page count, extracted capabilities, and parser warnings.

tools.name: get_document_map
tools.title: Get PDF page map
tools.description: Return page labels, sizes, native-text previews, bookmarks, and sparse-text warnings. Set page to include up to 500 positioned text blocks for that page.

outputSchema.description: PDF page map with dimensions, text coverage, and optional positioned blocks.

tools.name: search_document
tools.title: Search PDF text
tools.description: Find exact normalized text matches in native PDF text (no OCR). Results and excerpts are bounded.

query.description: Exact or normalized text to find.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

outputSchema.description: Bounded native-text search hits with page evidence.

tools.name: batch_search_document
tools.title: Batch search PDF text
tools.description: Search up to 20 exact normalized-text queries in one bounded call. Useful when an agent needs several clauses or fields from one PDF.

queries.description: One to twenty exact or normalized text queries.

outputSchema.description: Results for each bounded native-text search query.

tools.name: prepare_document_context
tools.title: Prepare cited PDF context
tools.description: Rank native-text pages for a question and return a bounded context pack with page, block, and excerpt evidence. No model call or OCR is used.

query.description: Question or terms used for deterministic page ranking.

outputSchema.description: Bounded cited context ranked from native PDF text.

tools.name: extract_document_fields
tools.title: Extract labeled PDF fields
tools.description: Extract caller-supplied literal labels and adjacent native-text values with page and block evidence. Missing labels return null; no semantic extraction or OCR is performed.

fields.description: One to twenty literal labels to extract.

outputSchema.description: Literal PDF field values with page and block evidence.

tools.name: read_document
tools.title: Read PDF pages
tools.description: Read extractable native text from up to 10 selected pages. Output is limited to 32,000 characters; scanned pages need OCR, which is not provided.

pages.description: One to ten 1-based page numbers to read.

outputSchema.description: Native text for the requested PDF pages.

tools.name: verify_document_citation
tools.title: Verify PDF text citation
tools.description: Check that a quote of 5 to 500 characters appears on the stated page in extracted native text. This does not establish truth or visual reading order.

quote.description: Quote to verify in native PDF text.

outputSchema.description: Citation verification result with exact page and text evidence.

tools.name: compare_pdfs
tools.title: Compare PDFs
tools.description: Compare page count and normalized native text between two separately authorized uploaded PDFs. Image-only and visual differences are not compared.

outputSchema.description: Page-by-page normalized native-text comparison result.

tools.name: validate_pdf_text
tools.title: Validate PDF text expectations
tools.description: Check that the PDF parses, has an optional expected page count, and contains required text. This does not perform PDF/A, signature, visual, or OCR validation.

required_text.description: Literal text strings that must be present.

outputSchema.description: PDF parsing, page-count, required-text, and native-text coverage checks.

tools.name: render_pdf_page_region
tools.title: Render PDF page region
tools.description: Render one authorized PDF page crop as PNG. x/y/width/height are normalized 0-1 page fractions; output is bounded to four million pixels.

outputSchema.description: Rendered PDF crop metadata; the image is returned as an MCP image content block.

tools.name: web_evidence
tools.title: Web evidence
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTPS page and return bounded citation-ready evidence.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL to fetch.

query.description: Optional phrase to locate in the page.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: Citation-ready bounded evidence fetched from a public HTTPS page.

tools.name: inspect_openapi
tools.title: Inspect OpenAPI
tools.description: Inspect a caller-supplied OpenAPI JSON document without fetching remote references.

spec.description: OpenAPI JSON document to inspect; remote references are not fetched.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: OpenAPI version, servers, operations, response codes, and warnings.

tools.name: plan_api_request
tools.title: Plan API request
tools.description: Select an OpenAPI operation and generate a safe request plan without executing it.

spec.description: OpenAPI JSON document containing the operation to plan.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: Safe request plan for a selected OpenAPI operation; no request is executed.

tools.name: diff_openapi
tools.title: Diff OpenAPI
tools.description: Compare two caller-supplied OpenAPI JSON documents.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: OpenAPI operation additions, removals, compatibility changes, and breaking flag.

tools.name: get_chain_balance
tools.title: get_chain_balance
tools.description: Read a native Base balance.

address.description: EVM wallet address whose native balance should be read.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier; use eip155:8453 for Base mainnet or eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia.

block.description: Optional block number or block tag such as latest.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: Native Base balance in wei at the requested block.

tools.name: get_chain_transaction
tools.title: get_chain_transaction
tools.description: Read a Base transaction and receipt.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash to inspect on the selected Base network.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier; use eip155:8453 for Base mainnet or eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: Base transaction, receipt, status, and confirmation count.

tools.name: get_erc20_balance
tools.title: get_erc20_balance
tools.description: Read one ERC-20 balance on Base.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address on the selected Base network.

address.description: EVM wallet address whose token balance should be read.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier; use eip155:8453 for Base mainnet or eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia.

block.description: Optional block number or block tag such as latest.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key used to make a paid retry idempotent.

outputSchema.description: ERC-20 token balance in atomic units with optional token metadata.
